title: Concept: Inline SVG carrying a script element
description: An inline SVG element that contains a script in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: SVG is markup, so a script inside it runs with the page's privileges, and sanitisers that allow SVG but strip script tags are bypassed by the element nesting.
applicability: Deployments that render an inline SVG element that contains a script into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: SVG is markup, so a script inside it runs with the page's privileges, and sanitisers that allow SVG but strip script tags are bypassed by the element nesting.
